WITH gender_counts AS (
  SELECT c.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT i.order_id) AS invoiced_order_count
  FROM Invoices AS i
  JOIN Orders AS o ON o.order_id = i.order_id
  JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
  GROUP BY c.gender
), gender_shares AS (
  SELECT gender, invoiced_order_count,
         CAST(invoiced_order_count AS DECIMAL(38,18)) / SUM(invoiced_order_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM gender_counts
)
SELECT gender, invoiced_order_count, share,
       share - AVG(share) OVER () AS above_average_share
FROM gender_shares
WHERE share > AVG(share) OVER ();
